purpose: Per protein x region x time window x sample state: is there dynamics, with evidence for, against, and gaps. Built ONLY from evidence-layer rows; no new papers, no web.

inputs.evidence_rows: ~/dynamics_atlas_work/outputs/gina_review_round1/evidence_rows.csv plus Appendix_rows sheet of RelaxDB_CPMG_evidence_round1.xlsx; row ids exactly as in the workbook ID column (e.g. CYPA-r1, KRAS-xiang2026-r1)
inputs.source_texts: ~/dynamics_atlas_work/sources_cache/ (read only, to check a value cited by an evidence row)

region.residues_entry: list of entry-numbered residues, or 'unlocalized' when the source gives only a global value
region.numbering_note: offset or construct numbering, empty if none
region.functional_site: only if the source states it (active site, binding interface, hinge); else empty

sample_state.binding_state: apo | bound:<ligand or partner> | mixed | unknown
sample_state.conditions: temperature; pH; buffer; Mg/metal; nucleotide; other — as reported

judgment_row.direction: detected | measured_not_detected | artefact_suspected | unclear_second_process | not_measured | search_insufficient

detection.observable: Rex, dispersion amplitude, CEST dip, R1rho, S2, line broadening, HDX rate, structure difference, MD fluctuation
detection.fit_model: two-state global | per-residue | cluster | none | other
detection.detection_window: REQUIRED when direction = measured_not_detected: method, field, temperature, nuCPMG or B1 range, and what exchange it could not see

judgment_row.evidence_rows: list of evidence row ids; REQUIRED, at least one, except direction = not_measured or search_insufficient
judgment_row.conflicts_with: judgment ids that state the opposite for the SAME comparable proposition (same region, window, comparable state); empty otherwise
judgment_row.evidence_strength: direct_measurement | indirect | inference_from_mutant | inference_from_homolog | md_only | structure_only
judgment_row.function_link: only if the source states that the motion relates to function; else empty
judgment_row.relaxdb_relation: pending_legend (until the RelaxDB label legend is confirmed)

rules: Never give one global 'dynamic' verdict per protein; give verdicts per time window. Low S2 is ps-ns evidence only; high S2 is not evidence against us-ms exchange.
measured_not_detected is not 'no dynamics'; it is 'not seen in this detection window under these conditions'.
A flat dispersion at one temperature and a detected one at another are a condition difference, not a conflict.
Mutant, homolog or non-WT-condition evidence may support a WT verdict only with evidence_strength inference_from_mutant / inference_from_homolog.
A global kex is never assigned to single residues; region = residues the authors report.
A structure difference alone does not fix a slow timescale: use time_window undetermined unless the source gives one. Do not assign HDX or MD to a window by method name alone.
Suspected artefacts (phosphate or other anion binding, aggregation, proline isomerization, lanthanide tags, EDTA vs Mg) use direction artefact_suspected with the reason.
If no evidence row covers a method class or region, write not_measured only when the workbook search covered it; otherwise search_insufficient.
Do not invent values; empty string when the source does not state it.

Granularity (v0.2): one row per state x group/cluster. A temperature or field series from one paper (or one global/Arrhenius fit) is ONE row with the values listed per temperature; split by temperature only when different papers or methods give the values or the conclusion changes with temperature.
Author-defined clusters/groups (named residue sets) keep their region (residue list or functional_site name); 'unlocalized' is only for a global fit whose residues the authors do not list.
Ligand binding/unbinding kinetics (kon/koff, ZZ-exchange of ligand) are not conformational dynamics: verdict unresolved with reason 'binding kinetics', never counted in a window answer.
In the fast-exchange limit pB is not separable: write 'not separable (fast exchange)' instead of a fitted population.
Put recurring caveats (e.g. a unit printed as Hz) once in buffer_note, not in every row.

MD-only or structure-only evidence may give dynamic_in_window only with evidence_strength md_only/structure_only and time_window undetermined (unless the source states a timescale); never unresolved merely because it is MD.
When a source reports a protein-wide order-parameter average, record both the flexible sites (detected) and the rigid remainder (measured_not_detected for ps-ns, with the S2 range).

residue_basis (v0.4) is optional: author_listed means an author-listed residue group; global_fit_unlocalized means an unlocalized global fit; per_residue means per-residue evidence. A global kex attached to multiple residues is an error unless residue_basis is author_listed or per_residue; residues_entry = unlocalized is exempt.

Reference state for a RelaxDB entry = the entry construct as deposited (its sequence), free and without ligand. When that construct is a mutant or engineered variant (e.g. CD9K P43G, 19335 5P12-RANTES-E66S), sample_state.is_wt_apo marks this entry-construct reference state and construct names the variant (rule added 2026-10-20 after batch-3 review).

protein_summary.wt_apo_answer: one sentence: does the WT apo protein show us-ms exchange, where, how fast, what population
protein_summary.buffer_note: buffer and condition caveats that apply to many rows (e.g. phosphate buffer without control)
